cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we talk about legal risks of generative AI.
cues.zh: 今天談生成式 AI 的法律風險。

cues.en: So for the exam, you need to know five legal risks.
cues.zh: 考試要知道五種。

cues.en: Here is Amazon Bedrock, we've got a foundation model.
cues.zh: 這是 Amazon Bedrock 的基礎模型。

cues.en: The first risk you need to know about is bias.
cues.zh: 第一，偏見。

cues.en: Now, if your training data has bias, then your model will likely also be biased.
cues.zh: 訓練資料有偏見，模型也可能有。

cues.en: And bias involves discriminating against certain groups of people, certain individuals.
cues.zh: 包括歧視某些群體或個人。

cues.en: So for example, based on age, race, sex, gender, and lots of other parameters that people need to be treated equally.
cues.zh: 例如年齡、種族、生理性別、性別等，本應平等對待。

cues.en: So for example, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission sued three companies where an AI model, they were using an AI model for hiring people and that model automatically discriminated
cues.zh: 例如平等就業機會委員會曾起訴三家公司，它們用 AI 招聘，模型自動歧視

cues.en: against older people.
cues.zh: 年長者。

cues.en: So anybody who's female over 55 and anybody who's male and over 60, they were automatically discarded from the hiring process and that was not fair.
cues.zh: 55 歲以上女性、60 歲以上男性，自動被排除，不公平。

cues.en: And therefore they got, yeah, they got in trouble for that.
cues.zh: 因此惹上法律問題。

cues.en: So next type of risk is hallucination.
cues.zh: 下一種，幻覺。

cues.en: So sometimes, models tend to try to fill in the gaps that exist in their training data by generating things that appear factually correct,
cues.zh: 模型有時填補訓練資料缺口，產生看似正確的內容，

cues.en: but that are actually not, and you need to be careful of that when they make things up.
cues.zh: 實際卻不對，要小心捏造。

cues.en: Next one is intellectual property.
cues.zh: 接著智慧財產權。

cues.en: Interestingly, the work of a foundation model or artificial intelligence cannot be copyrighted because it's not the work of a human.
cues.zh: 講者表示，基礎模型或 AI 的產出不能取得著作權，因為不是人類創作。

cues.en: At the same time, a generative AI model can violate copyrights of others, and that can be done if they generate text that is copying somebody else's text
cues.zh: 同時，生成式 AI 也可能侵犯他人著作權，例如文字複製別人的文字，

cues.en: or an image and things like that.
cues.zh: 或影像等等。

cues.en: So you have to keep a lookout for that.
cues.zh: 必須留意。

cues.en: Toxicity, so if the training data has a toxic, hateful, obscene content, then that can be part of the output and that can cause emotional damage,
cues.zh: 有毒內容，訓練資料有仇恨、猥褻內容，輸出也可能有，造成情緒、

cues.en: mental damage to humans, and can even incite violence against certain groups of people.
cues.zh: 心理傷害，甚至煽動針對特定群體的暴力。

cues.en: So that's another thing to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 也要記得。

cues.en: And finally, privacy.
cues.zh: 最後隱私。

cues.en: So during training, you definitely have to be careful about that and not include private personally identifiable information
cues.zh: 訓練時務必小心，不要將私人的可識別個人資訊，

cues.en: in the training data of the model or sensitive business data because that will be incorporated into the weights of the model and then that can be produced during output of the model.
cues.zh: 或敏感商業資料放入，因為可能納入權重，再於輸出洩露。

cues.en: During inference, it is a slightly different situation.
cues.zh: 推論時情況稍不同。

cues.en: Typically, models when you are prompting it, it's not going to remember.
cues.zh: 通常提示模型，它不會藉此永久記住。

cues.en: They only remember your prompts for the context window so that for the time you're interacting with it in that specific session, it's not going to change the weights of the model.
cues.zh: 只在上下文視窗內保留提示，供該次互動使用，不會改模型權重。

cues.en: But that's something to also keep in mind that most models like that, now they are some models that can learn on the fly and maybe they'll become more popular,
cues.zh: 大部分模型如此，但也有能即時學習的，可能更普及，

cues.en: so you also have to keep that in mind.
cues.zh: 所以也要注意。

cues.en: And also, some applications collect the prompt data for training and quality assurance and things like that.
cues.zh: 另外，有些應用會收集提示，用來訓練、品質保證等。

cues.en: So the data in the prompt, even though it might not be stored in the model, might be stored somewhere else, so that's something to also keep in mind.
cues.zh: 所以即使不存模型，提示資料也可能存別處，要記得。

cues.en: So those are the main five risks of generative AI.
cues.zh: 以上生成式 AI 五大風險。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to you back here next time, and until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 期待下次見，在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
